metadata.title: Redstone Equipment Workshop
metadata.description: A 12,000 sq ft agricultural equipment workshop in Redstone, Texas, supplied with FS-R36 roofing, FS-U36 wall panels, a custom trim package, and structural framing components.

metadata.title: Mesa County Distribution Center
metadata.description: A 38,500 sq ft clear-span distribution facility in San Angelo, Texas, supplied with a pre-engineered building package, insulated wall panels, standing-seam roofing, and loading-canopy components.

metadata.title: High Plains Agricultural Storage
metadata.description: An 18,400 sq ft hay and implement storage building in Levelland, Texas, supplied with FS-A36 roofing and wall panels, a ventilation package, framed openings, fasteners, and sealants.

metadata.title: Westline Service Facility
metadata.description: A 22,750 sq ft fleet service facility in Abilene, Texas, supplied with structural framing, roof and wall panels, interior liner panels, and custom formed trim.
